title: Delivery on Tree
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 3 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2\leq N \leq 10^4; 1\leq M \leq 2\times 10^5; 1\leq K \leq 10^3; 1\leq P_i \leq i; For every v\ (1\leq v \leq N), there are at most two i's such that P_i=v.; 1\leq S_j, T_j \leq N; S_j \neq T_j; All input values are integers.
